test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To hit the nail on the head

options.text: To express an idea with great precision

solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e.** 'To express an idea with great precision'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **To hit the nail on the head:** To describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem (सटीक वर्णन करना)

 
 
• **Example**: You hit the nail on the head when you said the problem is lack of communication.
 
 
 
• **To express an idea with great precision: **(एक विचार को बहुत शुद्धता से व्यक्त करना) - Accurately conveying a thought or opinion. 
 
• This option 4 directly reflects the idiom's meaning related to accurate expression or identification.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'To express an idea with great precision'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To hit something accurately:** (किसी चीज़ को सटीक रूप से मारना) - Physically striking something with precision.
 
• **To be indecisive: **(अनिश्चित होना) - Unable to make decisions quickly.
 
• **To miss an opportunity: **(एक अवसर को खो देना) - Failing to take advantage of a situation.

237:Tafa,
